exposure: Pregnancy weight gain z-scores (below, within, or above IOM recommendations)
cohort: Nulliparous individuals in the United States with prepregnancy overweight (n=955) or obesity (n=897).
finding: Pregnancy weight gain below the lower limit of IOM recommended ranges was not associated with a severity-weighted composite outcome of 10 adverse maternal and child health outcomes in individuals with prepregnancy overweight or obesity.
mod_finding: Pregnancy weight gain z-scores below the lower limit of recommended ranges were not associated with the severity-weighted composite outcome, which included unplanned cesarean delivery.
